0022600183.text: The Phoenix Suns, now 1-4 and on a three-game losing streak, host the Portland Trail Blazers, who are 5-1, have won two straight, and lead the Northwest Division, while Phoenix sits 12th in the West. Phoenix is without Mark Williams, who is out after shoulder surgery, and Jordan Goodwin is day-to-day with a calf injury and a game-time decision, while Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), both out. Portland beat Phoenix 124-83 in their last meeting, in Portland on October 21, leaving the Suns trailing 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after they won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
